cards.card_text: Hezekiah calls today "a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace…" and puts it this way: children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
cards.verse_text: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
